epics.title: Application Startup Remediation
epics.jtbd: When a user accesses the launched environment, I want the backend application to be fully running and healthy, so that all underlying features can be utilized and further verification can occur.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container startup failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The backend application container must start and remain running without silent crashes.
R2: The backend application must return HTTP 200 OK at the /health endpoint on port 18080.

slices.title: Patch application startup and health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the startup fix for this epic, I want to identify and resolve the root cause of the silent crash and connection refusal, so that the application is reachable at /health on port 18080.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application starts in its container environment,
When verifying the startup sequence,
Then the application logs indicate successful startup without silent crashes.
Given the docker-compose environment is running,
When an HTTP GET request is made to localhost:18080/health,
Then it returns a 200 OK response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce connection refused errors on port 18080 to 0
